whenToUse: A live website view: visitors right now, per-minute traffic, pages, sources and cities.
Wall screens or launch days where the page refreshes every few seconds.
avoidWhen: Historical analytics over weeks — use dashboard-12.
A general activity stream of workspace events — use list-11.
a11y: The activity feed is role="log" and the live count uses aria-live; a pause switch stops updates.
Keep the pause control reachable first so users can stop motion (WCAG 2.2.2).
